title: Add Phase 2 integration and regression test coverage
acceptance_criteria: A user-centric integration suite covers the Phase 2 flow from migrated local state through routine selection, weekly assignment, reminder settings, and reload persistence.
Tests assert unsupported notification behavior and do not require a real permission prompt, network, or service-worker registration.
Regression coverage confirms the exercise library, custom exercise validation, random routine generation, and existing navigation still work.
Tests are deterministic, independent, and use Arrange/Act/Assert structure with clear behavior-focused names.
The full test suite, lint, and production build pass from a clean web install.
